name: Parker Valdez
life: “I still remember an interviewer asking me to start that answer again.” People around Maré Coffee know Parker by a small Thursday habit. Parker likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: I was late for an interview. I described the crossing when they asked how I handle delays.
appearance: Parker has a long face and high cheekbones. Look for close-cropped dark curls. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a gray fisher's sweater with a knotted piece of sail thread on a key ring. In conversation Parker draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first.
personality: Parker is patient with a person learning and fiercely impatient with somebody pretending to know. A half-finished job left where a beginner can see it is an invitation, as far as Parker is concerned.
agenda: To explain the real delay at the interview.
family: Jamie Hamilton is Parker’s stepsibling. Parker makes the call. Jamie is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *A last ship together*, Jamie says, “I make the retirement plaques. One misspelling on the old time sheets has become a nickname they both want on the brass.”
connections: Talia Carvalho. A passenger's groceries become part of a candidate's truthful account of lateness.
